svg.title: PayGuard AI merchant defense buffer cover
svg.desc: Synthetic concept illustration from the merchant perspective. The three lifecycle zones show an AUP preflight warning, sales velocity and fulfillment evidence readiness, and dispute evidence awaiting human review. PayPal Sandbox, AG Grid, and bounded Gemini AI support the demonstration. This is not a product screenshot, official PayPal notice, provider verdict, or claim that account limitations can be predicted or prevented.
